description.value: As a bonus action, you can spend one or more of your tracker droid's Hit Dice to have it release a pulse of ion energy. Every creature within 5 feet of the droid attempts a Constitution save against your tech save DC, taking ion damage equal to the number of Hit Dice spent, rolled at the same die size as the droid's Hit Die, on a failure, or half that on a success. Any unworn, uncarried electronics caught in the blast are disabled until rebooted.
